# Events

> Plainkit 0.1.0-alpha.1. Generated by scripts/build-skills.mjs from Generated/PkGeneratedEvents.cs. Do not edit: change the source and run the generator.

An event with a detail gives `EventCallback<PkXxxEventArgs>`; the args class has one nullable property per field of the element's detail (set only when the element sends it). An event with no detail gives `EventCallback`; `click` gives `MouseEventArgs`. A change event that drives a value is also exposed as a two-way `@bind-` parameter.
